text:
sam: Heads up — found a weird billing visibility case during the canary rollout. Reconnect + resume + toolcall ends up with provisional ledger rows attached to the old session id; console shows 0 provisional credits then ledger later reassigns and you get a spike. Logs below.

maria: Can you drop the full trace / steps? Is this reproducible in local?

sam: Only on canary so far. Repro steps: start a streaming session, issue a mid-stream toolcall (rerank), simulate a TCP drop, client reconnects using resume token. Server stitches and continues but ledger rows for the suffix remain tagged to original session id and don’t surface in the console query for the new session.

ida: :eyes: Is this happening in the router handoff path or ledger commit path? Sounds like a session-id reassignment race.

max: My read: handoff creates session B while provisional tokens were written for A. The ledger still holds provisional rows with A until commit, and the console queries by confirmed session id (B) -> UI misses provisional counts. On finalize we reassign and it looks like a late spike.

sam: Minimal log excerpt (timestamps are relative):
```
[00:00:01] router: create_session id=A resume_token=rt-xy
[00:00:07] runtime: toolcall tool=rerank tokens=42 provisional=true session=A
[00:00:10] network: tcp drop client -> disconnect session=A
[00:00:11] router: create_session id=B resume_from=rt-xy (handoff)
[00:00:12] ledger: provisional_row session=A tokens=42 id=pr-987
[00:00:13] stitch: stitch_pr rows -> reassign session=B id=pr-987
[00:00:14] console_query: sessions=[B] provisional_sum=0 (query happened before reassign)
[00:00:16] ledger: finalize reassign commit -> provisional_sum now shows up tied to B
```

dev-bot: deploybot: canary/ledger-service rolled 2025-02-28 -> v1.12.4

ops: If provisional rows are written then reattached, the UI ordering/timing is the root cause. Do we have an idempotency key on the toolcall write? Maybe group by toolcall id instead of session id for provisional visibility?

maria: UX ask: console should show provisional credits by route/model across both session ids and resume tokens during rollouts. Filing a quick ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-12345

ida: Proposal: when resume/handoff happens, attach provisional rows to both session id and resume_token (or a stable handoff id). UI can then union results by token. Caveat: storage and query changes + backfill for older rows.

max: Alternate: router emits last_active_resume_token as part of route metadata at handoff. Console can union by that token without changing ledger schema. Slightly less invasive.

sam: I'll prototype server-side change to attach the provisional token row to both ids at write time (flag-gated). Will add an e2e that simulates the reconnect handoff. @maria can you mock the console view so we can validate before rolling?

maria: Yep — will wire a flag-gated panel and a quick metric that shows provisional-vs-confirmed over time for the canary route. :thumbsup:

ops: Also capture billing-side samples so we can decide whether backfill is needed if customers were affected. Prefer avoiding surprise invoices.

sam: Thanks — opening a PR w/ logs + e2e today and will attach the console mock. Let me know if anyone thinks the router-emitted-token approach is strictly better. Thread will be used for patch notes.
